### Funciones independientes:

#### `def hash_password(plaintext_password)` (Línea 4)
- **Propósito:** Create a password hash from a given string for protecting a worksheet
only. This will not work for encrypting a workbook.

This method is based on the algorithm provided by
Daniel Rentz of OpenOffice and the PEAR package
Spreadsheet_Excel_Writer by Xavier Noguer <xnoguer@rezebra.com>.
See also http://blogs.msdn.com/b/ericwhite/archive/2008/02/23/the-legacy-hashing-algorithm-in-open-xml.aspx
- **Firma:** `def hash_password(plaintext_password)`
- **Retorno / Efectos:** Consulta código fuente.
